terms.title: Terms of service
terms.introduction: These terms are placeholder text for a demo forum. They describe, in general words, what a community like this one usually expects from its members.
terms.accountResponsibility: You are responsible for what is posted from your account.
terms.accountLimit: One account per person. Do not share it or sell it.
terms.accountUsername: Choose a username that does not impersonate somebody else.
terms.postsRights: You keep the rights to what you write. By posting, you allow the forum to display it to other members and visitors.
terms.postsSpam: Spam, advertising or referral links outside the areas meant for them.
terms.postsAbuse: Content that is illegal, hateful or that harasses another member.
terms.moderationDescription: Staff may edit, move or remove content and may limit or close accounts that break these rules. Decisions can be discussed in private with a moderator, not in public threads.
terms.creditsDescription: Credits, awards and shop items have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged or refunded.
terms.changesDescription: These terms may change. The date at the top of the page shows the latest revision.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.introduction: This policy is placeholder text for a demo forum. It lists the kind of information a community site typically handles.
privacy.collectionAccount: Account details: username, email address and the profile fields you choose to fill in.
privacy.collectionContent: Content: threads, posts, profile messages and conversations you write.
privacy.collectionTechnical: Technical data: browser and operating system, shown next to your posts and in your list of devices.
privacy.usageDescription: The information is used to run the forum: to show your content, to keep your account secure and to prevent abuse. It is not sold.
privacy.cookiesDescription: A single cookie keeps you signed in. No advertising or tracking cookies are set.
privacy.choicesDescription: You can edit your profile at any time from your <account>account</account>. To have your account and personal data removed, use the <contact>contact page</contact>.
privacy.retentionDescription: Posts stay visible after an account is closed unless their removal is requested. Technical data is kept only as long as it is needed.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.introduction: This notice is placeholder text for a demo forum. The details below are generic examples, not a real company.
legal.hostingDescription: The site is hosted by an example provider. Its name and address would be listed here.
legal.contentDescription: Members are responsible for the content they publish. Posts reflect the opinion of their authors, not of the publisher.
legal.reportingDescription: If you believe something on the forum infringes your rights, send the address of the page and a short explanation through the <contact>contact page</contact>. Reports are reviewed by staff.
legal.propertyDescription: The forum name, logo and interface belong to the publisher. Content posted by members remains theirs, as described in the <terms>terms</terms>.

contact.title: Contact
contact.introduction: The details below are placeholders for a demo forum.
contact.responseDescription: Staff usually answer within two working days. For anything about a specific post, include a link to it.
